title: Oh Betty Jaletti

approach: Set brand strategy, product direction, and GTM before layering in automation.
Directed two AI-agent systems with staged human approval gates rather than fully unsupervised generation.
Authored the prompt and context engineering, including structured knowledge files and brand-voice / claims guardrails.
Contributed directly in Python and Streamlit, including a shipped bug fix with its own regression test.
owned: Brand positioning, product roadmap, and GTM
BettyOS, a Claude-powered creative-ops pipeline for campaign content
A content pipeline using OpenAI structured outputs, Shopify GraphQL, and Google Sheets sync
Quality control, human-approval checkpoints, and brand-voice guardrails

Creative-ops agent system with approval gates
SEO content pipeline with scoring, drafting, and QC
Operating knowledge files and prompt architecture

SEO drafts scored and produced with automated QC plus approval checkpoints
Strategy and systems owned by the same person who can ship in the codebase

title: Three-brand D2C portfolio
summary: Set the growth baseline for a three-brand Shopify portfolio, then rebuilt navigation and merchandising around shopper intent after a full funnel audit.
objective: Own growth strategy across a three-brand portfolio: establish the performance baseline, prioritize the roadmap, and fix the structural leaks in analytics, merchandising, and product discovery.
approach: Led a full GA4 + Shopify funnel audit and isolated where demand was leaking.
Found 26K+ product-page sessions converting at 0.22%, a collection drawing ~600 sessions at 0% conversion, and 404s bleeding traffic.
Rebuilt navigation and merchandising around shopper intent instead of internal catalog logic.
Wrote a portfolio-wide Product Organization SOP and metadata governance system, then directed human-in-the-loop AI workflows for catalog cleanup.
owned: Growth strategy, baseline, and prioritized roadmap
Analytics, merchandising, SEO, and AI-readiness infrastructure
Navigation and merchandising IA across all three brands
PDP optimization framework and metadata governance
deliverables: Funnel audit with conversion leak diagnosis
Intent-based navigation and merchandising rebuild
PDP framework modeled to lift conversion up to 30% and AOV up to 25%
Product Organization SOP and HITL AI catalog cleanup
results: Largest conversion leaks identified and prioritized instead of treated as generic CRO tickets
Shopper-intent architecture in place across three storefronts
Ad-feed quality, organic search, and AI/semantic discoverability improved through metadata governance
nextSteps: Sequence the PDP and collection tests against the modeled lift, then keep catalog hygiene on the HITL automation loop.
